changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0018. Exercise library. TenantId NULL is a system exercise and is immutable to tenants. A non-null TenantId is a custom exercise owned by that workspace. Index review: PK_Exercises; UX_Exercises_SystemName enforces one live system name; UX_Exercises_TenantId_Name enforces one live custom name per tenant; IX_Exercises_Catalog serves the active system list. Performance note: catalog reads filter IsActive and DeletedAt, so both unique indexes are filtered and the system list does not scan custom rows.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE app.Exercises ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, Name NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, Description NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, Instructions NVARCHAR(2000) NULL, MuscleGroup NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, Equipment NVARCHAR(100) NULL, ExerciseType NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, Difficulty NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, VideoUrl NVARCHAR(500) NULL, ImageUrl NVARCHAR(500) NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_Exercises PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_Exercises_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_Exercises_MuscleGroup CHECK (MuscleGroup IN (N'Chest', N'Back', N'Shoulders', N'Biceps', N'Triceps', N'Legs', N'Glutes', N'Core', N'FullBody', N'Cardio', N'Mobility')), CONSTRAINT CK_Exercises_Type CHECK (ExerciseType IN (N'Strength', N'Cardio', N'Mobility', N'Stretching', N'Bodyweight')), CONSTRAINT CK_Exercises_Difficulty CHECK (Difficulty IN (N'Beginner', N'Intermediate', N'Advanced')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Exercises_SystemName ON app.Exercises (Name) WHERE TenantId IS NULL AND DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Exercises_TenantId_Name ON app.Exercises (TenantId, Name) WHERE TenantId IS NOT NULL AND DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_Exercises_Catalog ON app.Exercises (Name) WHERE TenantId IS NULL AND DeletedAt IS NULL AND IsActive = 1;
